item.title: Benchmarking Recycling Yield for End-of-Life Solar Panels
item.summary: Measures silicon and silver recovery rates across three recycling processes on 200 decommissioned panels.
item.excerpt: We report recovery yields for silicon, silver and glass under thermal, mechanical and chemical delamination...

topic.title: What recovery yields do end-of-life solar panel recycling processes reach?

representative_observations: Chemical delamination recovers 94% of silver from monocrystalline panels
